title: Project creature and action attack mechanics
description:
Problem:
Creature records expose stat blocks, traits, and action arrays, but attacks and effects are mostly raw text. Deterministic combat tools cannot reliably extract attack bonus, reach/range, targets, hit damage, save DC, recharge, or condition application.

Implement:
- Add optional typed action mechanics projections.
- Cover common SRD action patterns:
  - Melee Weapon Attack
  - Ranged Weapon Attack
  - Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack
  - Hit damage dice/type
  - reach/range
  - one target / target count
  - recharge notation
  - saving throw DC and ability where explicit
- Preserve original action text.

Acceptance criteria:
- Representative creature attacks can be executed or previewed by deterministic tooling without parsing prose at runtime.
- Ambiguous actions remain prose-backed with no invented fields.
- Projection diagnostics identify remaining prose-only actions.
- Tests cover common attack forms.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
close_reason: Implemented first-pass source-backed mechanics projections for spells, creature/action entries, features/ancestry/feats, and hazards; regenerated SRD pack; added schema validation, report, thaw note, and tests.
